newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bank Negara to buy stake in Dutch bank.
newsitem.headline: Bank Negara to buy stake in Dutch bank.

text.p: State-controlled PT Bank Negara Indonesia said on Thursday that it has an intention to purchase shares owned by Indonesia's central bank, Bank Indonesia, in N.V. De Indonesische Overzeese Bank (Indover) in Amsterdam.
Bank Negara said in a statment that the proposed transaction was categorised as a conflict of interest transaction.

"Therefore, it is required to have approval from minority shareholders at an extraordinary general meeting," the statement said, without giving details. It also did not state the amount of shares it intended to purchase and the cost.
Bank Negara said the transaction also required approval from the authorities in Indonesia and the Netherlands.
A company official contacted by Reuters declined to give details. "So far, we can only disclose what you have seen in the statement," she said.
